title: kate-ui: keep color when the paint budget is zero
summary: highlight_step with a zero budget leaves plain_from empty when the viewport is already behind the checkpoint. A viewport that still needs color stays plain. The test goes in the existing highlight tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: fn highlight_step(checkpoint: u32, first: u32, last: u32, budget: u32) -> HighlightStep

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Keep the existing pub(crate) on highlight_step. Do not add an attribute. highlight.rs has one test module named tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Replace the combined if last < first || budget == 0 with two separate returns. First: if last < first { return HighlightStep { ensure_through: None, plain_from: Some(first) }; } Second: if budget == 0 { return HighlightStep { ensure_through: None, plain_from: if last < checkpoint { None } else { Some(first) } }; } The inner choice is one if expression. Do not write if budget == 0 { if last < checkpoint { ... } }. Leave the later if last < checkpoint and if first > checkpoint as they are. Do not touch resume_color_line, PAINT_LINE_BUDGET, CATCH_UP_LINE_BUDGET, or COLOR_LINE_BUDGET. The test a_zero_budget_keeps_color_behind_the_checkpoint calls highlight_step(1000, 10, 50, 0). ensure_through is None. plain_from is None. highlight_step(0, 0, 39, 0) has ensure_through None and plain_from Some(0). highlight_step(0, 10, 5, 0) has plain_from Some(10). Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: highlight::tests::a_zero_budget_keeps_color_behind_the_checkpoint
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. highlight_step(1000, 10, 50, 0) sets plain_from to Some(10). After the change plain_from is None and ensure_through is None. highlight_step(0, 0, 39, 0) still sets plain_from to Some(0). highlight_step(0, 10, 5, 0) still sets plain_from to Some(10).
